symptom: `create microflow M.F returns Boolean as $b begin … end;` gives "missing '(' at 'returns'", "missing ':' at 'Boolean'" and a follow-on "extraneous input 'return'"; with `$l: List of M.Item` and no parentheses "missing '(' at '$l'" / "missing ')' at 'returns'" — nothing says the parameter parentheses are mandatory
cause: ANTLR single-token insertion supplies the `(` and then parses `returns Boolean` as a parameter named `returns`, so every error lands on a token after the real mistake; no hint keyed on the header shape
insight: When recovery INSERTS the missing token, the messages describe the recovered parse, not the input — key the hint off the source line (`create [or modify] microflow|nanoflow|rule <name>` followed by returns / $ / as / begin instead of `(`), which a correct header cannot match. deduplicateHint already collapses the same hint on one line, so the cascade carries one explanation; the follow-on error on the body's later line is left as is (suppressing it would need cross-error state).
